notes.title: Release Day!
notes.notes:
Hello!

If you enjoy tower defense then you'll enjoy Domain Defense VR.  Launch day was a long time coming and it's finally out.  Please share any reviews, videos, images, or even an elusive bug in the community!

Thank you to those of you who support us.

Inclusion Studios
